```{r setup, include = FALSE}
in_pkgdown <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("IN_PKGDOWN"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  eval = !in_pkgdown,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 6
)
if (!in_pkgdown) library(targets)

# Discover targets store
proj_dir <- Sys.getenv("TAR_PROJECT")
tar_store <- NULL
if (proj_dir != "" && dir.exists(file.path(proj_dir, "_targets"))) {
  tar_store <- file.path(proj_dir, "_targets")
} else if (dir.exists("_targets")) {
  tar_store <- "_targets"
} else if (dir.exists("../_targets")) {
  tar_store <- "../_targets"
}

safe_tar_read <- function(name) {
  if (!is.null(tar_store)) {
    val <- tryCatch(tar_read_raw(name, store = tar_store), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(val) && !(is.character(val) && length(val) == 1 && grepl("not available", val, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
      return(val)
    }
  }
  rds_candidates <- c(
    system.file(paste0("extdata/vignettes/", name, ".rds"), package = "coMMpass"),
    file.path("inst/extdata/vignettes", paste0(name, ".rds")),
    file.path("../inst/extdata/vignettes", paste0(name, ".rds"))
  )
  for (rds in rds_candidates) {
    if (nzchar(rds) && file.exists(rds)) return(readRDS(rds))
  }
  NULL
}
```

cat("::: {.callout-note}\n## Online documentation\nThis vignette shows pre-computed results from the targets pipeline. Some outputs may appear as placeholders in the online version.\n:::\n")
```

## Overview

> See the [Glossary](glossary.html) for term definitions used throughout this project.

- Compares tumor vs normal or baseline vs relapse samples
- Three complementary methods: **DESeq2**, **edgeR**, **limma-voom**
- Consensus genes (significant in all three) used for pathway analysis
- Visualizations: PCA, volcano plot, MA plot, heatmap, method comparison

> **Note:** This vignette was built in CI with `sample_limit=10`. Local builds
> default to 100 samples. Numbers below reflect the CI subset.

## Method Comparison

Summary of DE genes detected by each method (DESeq2, edgeR, limma-voom) and their consensus overlap.

```{r method-summary}
safe_tar_read("vig_de_method_table")
```

```{r method-barplot, fig.cap = "Number of significant DE genes identified by each method (|log2FC| > 1, padj < 0.05). Concordance across methods indicates robust signals. DESeq2 with apeglm shrinkage tends to be more conservative."}
safe_tar_read("vig_de_method_barplot")
```

## Principal Component Analysis

- Computed from top 500 most variable genes after [VST](https://bioconductor.org/packages/DESeq2/)
- VST stabilizes variance across the expression range
- Preferred over raw counts or logCPM for exploratory visualization

```{r pca-plot, fig.cap = "PCA of VST-transformed RNA-seq counts. Each point is a sample. Variance explained per PC shown on axes. Computed from top 500 most variable genes. See DESeq2::vst() for the transformation method."}
safe_tar_read("vig_pca_plot")
```

## Volcano Plot

- Statistical significance (-log10 adjusted p-value) vs biological effect size (log2 fold change)
- Genes in upper corners are both statistically significant and biologically meaningful

```{r volcano, fig.cap = "Volcano plot of DESeq2 results. X-axis: log2 fold change (apeglm-shrunken if available). Y-axis: -log10 adjusted p-value. Dashed lines: |LFC| = 1 and padj = 0.05 thresholds. Top 10 genes labeled by adjusted p-value. Red = upregulated, blue = downregulated."}
safe_tar_read("vig_volcano_plot")
```

## MA Plot

- Bland-Altman plot: mean expression (x-axis) vs fold change (y-axis)
- Reveals whether DE signals concentrate at particular expression levels
- Detects bias in fold-change estimates

```{r ma-plot, fig.cap = "MA plot of DESeq2 results. X-axis: log10(baseMean + 1). Y-axis: log2 fold change. Red points are significant at padj < 0.05 and |LFC| > 1. Dashed lines at LFC = +/-1. Genes with low mean expression tend to have higher variance."}
safe_tar_read("vig_ma_plot")
```

## Heatmap of Top DE Genes

The heatmap shows Z-score scaled VST expression for the most significant
genes. Rows (genes) and columns (samples) are hierarchically clustered.

```{r heatmap, fig.height = 10, fig.cap = "Heatmap of top 50 DE genes by adjusted p-value. Expression values are VST-transformed and Z-score scaled per gene. Blue = below mean, red = above mean. Hierarchical clustering applied to both rows and columns. See data dictionary for gene ID mappings."}
safe_tar_read("vig_heatmap_plot")
```

## Consensus Genes

Genes identified as significant by all three methods (DESeq2, edgeR, limma)
represent the highest-confidence DE candidates.

```{r consensus, results='asis'}
safe_tar_read("vig_consensus_text")
```

## Paired Longitudinal DE

For patients with samples at multiple timepoints (baseline and relapse),
a paired design (`~ patient_id + visit`) controls for inter-patient
variability and tests for within-patient expression changes over time.

```{r paired-de-text, results='asis'}
safe_tar_read("vig_paired_de_text")
```

```{r paired-de-plot, fig.cap = "Volcano plot for paired DE analysis (baseline vs relapse). Same thresholds as main analysis."}
safe_tar_read("vig_paired_de_plot")
```

## Annotated DE Results

Gene symbols make Ensembl IDs interpretable. The `annotate_genes()` function
maps Ensembl IDs to HGNC symbols using
[MSigDB gene mappings](https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb/).

```{r annotated-de}
safe_tar_read("vig_annotated_de_table")
```

## Pathway Enrichment Visualizations

### GSEA Enrichment Dot Plot

Gene Set Enrichment Analysis using the full ranked gene list against MSigDB Hallmark pathways.

```{r gsea-dotplot, fig.cap = "GSEA enrichment dot plot of MSigDB Hallmark pathways. Dot color: -log10(adjusted p-value). Dot size: number of genes in the pathway. Pathways sorted by significance. See MSigDB Hallmark for pathway definitions."}
safe_tar_read("vig_gsea_dotplot")
```

### ORA Enrichment Bar Plot

Over-representation analysis testing whether consensus DE genes are enriched in specific pathways.

```{r ora-barplot, fig.cap = "Over-representation analysis (ORA) of consensus DE genes in MSigDB Hallmark pathways. Bar length: -log10(adjusted p-value). Fisher's exact test (hypergeometric). Only consensus genes (significant in DESeq2, edgeR, and limma) are tested."}
safe_tar_read("vig_ora_barplot")
```

## Next Steps

- **Pathway analysis**: Consensus DE genes are tested for enrichment in
  MSigDB Hallmark, KEGG, and other collections. See the
  [pathway analysis vignette](pathway-analysis.html).
- **Survival stratification**: DE gene signatures can inform survival
  analysis. See the [survival analysis vignette](survival-analysis.html).
- **Cytogenetic context**: See the [EDA vignette](exploratory-analysis.html)
  for the cytogenetic landscape underlying these expression changes.

## Data Sources

Results in this vignette are derived from the
[MMRF CoMMpass study](https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/projects/MMRF-COMMPASS)
(MMRF-COMMPASS, ~1,143 patients), downloaded via
[TCGAbiolinks](https://bioconductor.org/packages/TCGAbiolinks/).
The pipeline runs with a configurable `sample_limit` (default 100; CI uses 10).

For full citations, data access tiers, and the distinction between
pipeline data and synthetic test data, see the
[Data Sources](data-sources.html) vignette.
